g.text: Panel A plots the stored per-stage hit and false-alarm rates: ours from the power-scoped exploration arm at each stage’s qualified dose, theirs as recovered from Fig 21. Their OLMo cells run ~800 injected / ~80 control per config against our tens, and differ in layer and dose coverage, so the two series are not matched and the record states no test between

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #111827

g.text: them. The iso-d′ curves are a drawn reference grid — not a fit, and not a stored quantity. No d′ is computed for any point here: the record stores sensitivity as TPR − FPR (+0.095 at SFT, 0.000 at DPO, 0.000 at Instruct, every interval including zero), and the note’s claim that a metacognition indicator should be scored on d′ rather than on the specificity

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #111827

g.text: transition is an argument it flags for contest, not a measured result. Panel B carries the false-alarm figures the note quotes in §4.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: CONVENTIONS filled ● = ours · open ■ = external source · stage ramp light→dark = base → SFT → DPO → Instruct (order charter-fixed; palette PROVISIONAL, FLAG 5) · amber = threshold or scope warning · no axis is truncated: the left panel is the full unit square and the middle panel is a labelled magnification of the same points.

text.style: font-size: 6.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b7280

g.text: PROVENANCE Tier 1 for every “ours” value. “Theirs” is the design seat’s recovery of an external source, cited as such and not a committed artifact of this program. Claims restated from RESEARCH-NOTE-v0_1-draft.md (design seat, 2026-10-05) §4 link 4, §9 and §10. Rendered 2026-10-06 under DRAFTSMAN.md v1.0, with no statistic, fit or test computed here.
